Privacy

How your consultation details are used

What this website keeps

Nothing. The consultation form runs in your browser. Your name, phone number and note are not sent to a server and are not saved on this website.

How the request reaches the hospital

When you press “Send on WhatsApp”, WhatsApp opens with your request typed out. It is delivered only if you press send there. From that point WhatsApp’s own privacy terms apply to the message.

Who reads it

Hospital staff read the message so they can call you back and fix a time with the doctor. It is not shared for advertising.

The language setting

If you switch to Telugu, your browser remembers that choice on your own device. You can clear it by clearing this site’s data in the browser.

The map

The map in the Visit section is supplied by Google Maps and loads only when you scroll to it. Google’s privacy terms apply to it.

Questions

Call +91 94927 35797 or ask at the front desk.
